AGRICULTURE — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.

6. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Storage of Crop Produce? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Storage of Crop Produce.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Storage of Crop Produce.

   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Storage of Crop Produce.

   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.

13. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix? (1 mark)

15. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

16. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Integrated Farming? (1 mark)

   B. Milk souring

   D. Iron rusting

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art? (1 mark)

   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C
